$comment: AUTHORITY on where every subject lives. The folder tree is DERIVED from this file, never the other way round: once folders encode the taxonomy, a hand-edited recategorization is a corpus-wide link break, so moves go through scripts/apply-taxonomy.mjs and nothing else. `layout` says whether the tree has been materialized yet - "flat" means subjects still sit directly under the bundle and the cap check reports rather than fails. A subject is identified by its bare slug everywhere (technique@owner, shared_with, index.json, signals/); only its location is nested. Gated by scripts/check-bundles.mjs via scripts/lib/taxonomy.mjs.
